_readme: Single source of truth for the epistemic-machine enumerations. The logical machine has SIX rows (README table); the cinematic machine has FIVE panels (poster/gif/mp4). The compression map records exactly how the film merges logical operations, and the bridge caption must accompany any embed of the media. tests/unit/docs/test_epistemic_machine_manifest.py holds README.md to this file so the two enumerations cannot silently diverge again; any surface embedding the media (including external sites) should copy the bridge caption or this mapping.
_non_claim: This manifest describes an explainer graphic. It is not evidence for any mathematical or empirical claim; the theorem ledger and validation matrix carry those.

bridge_caption: The figure groups the two middle stages differently from the table below: it shows Feasible Worlds for the identification kernel, and merges bounds with their witnesses into one panel. Six rows, five panels, same machine.

poster_text.headline: CC is a claim discipline wrapped around a mathematical kernel.
poster_text.subhead: It separates what was measured, what was assumed, what was computed, and what remains unproved.
verdict_lines: CC does not tell you which convenient world to believe.
It tells you which worlds the evidence has not yet ruled out.
poster_text.closing_quote: Make the claim smaller. Make the evidence stronger.
